title: The Fine-Tuning Link on a Budget: How Few Benign Examples Unlock Harm?

original_idea.body: # The Fine-Tuning Link on a Budget. LoRA fine-tune a small model on a benign dataset, checkpointing frequently, and chart how refusal rate on StrongREJECT-small degrades as a side effect.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Charting benign-fine-tuning safety erosion is a recognized diffuse open-weight threat; clear chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: LoRA fine-tune + checkpointed refusal eval on small model; guided, single GPU.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused erosion-curve experiment; fine-tuning pipeline is a real dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open-weight ecosystem threat labs underweight; public benchmarks.

low_compute.reasoning: LoRA fine-tuning of an 8B model on a single GPU, a few GPU-hours.

novelty.reasoning: Benign fine-tuning eroding safety is well-documented (Qi et al. and follow-ups).
